scope: Consume authenticated, request-correlated maintenance scan and pressure JSON-RPC results from NIP-59-wrapped ContextVM kind-25910 responses and wire them into fleet hygiene reconciliation.
intended_behavior: Bahia registers exact scan and pressure rumor IDs before relay publication and accepts a result only from the worker addressed by that Bahia-authored request.

The existing ContextVM ingress delivers response-shaped messages to the observation source only after NIP-59 provenance, inner validation, routing, replay, and deduplication checks, without entering request authorization or emitting responder noise.
Canonical v1.4 scan and pressure bindings plus consumer-side invariants gate all cached observations.
Scan and pressure freshness are independent and remain anchored to the pre-scan reconcile pass timestamp.
A truncated scan records its total and timestamp but exposes no candidates for quarantine; independently valid pressure may still trigger garbage collection.
Production app composition passes the real source to both the maintenance publisher and hygiene reconciler and registers it with the shared encrypted transport.
out_of_scope: Changing canonical result schemas or worker emission behavior.
Persisting request correlations or observations across Bahia restarts.
Changing Tier-2 relocate or purge approval behavior.
